review_description: Have had the solar panels installed for at least 1 month but nil further progress. My sister had a battery backup installed and this was totally stuffed up to the extent that the previous solar system was rendered inoperable. Very poor service indeed.

Sales were extremely helpful and informativeInstallers damaged the carport roof and said it was unavoidable. They would fix the roof but not reinstall panels, leaving us with a very small system. Gave a (very)small discount on price insteadInstallers also dodgied up the inverter install, cutting the warranty void if damaged tag to open up the box to install cable instead of using the plug provided.Inverter died, replaced under warranty as it was a known problem with that batch of inverters, but 10 months after the inverter died, only just got the new one installed as the customer support is laughable.Lost emails, computer viruses, not answering phone, a usually full mailbox but don't call back if you do get to leave a message, and trying to make us do the chasing around for a replacement plug instead of doing it themselves.I've had every excuse under the sun, and the problem was only solved because Samil (inverter manufacturer) has amazing customer service.And don't bother trying to complain, when asked for a manager or supervisor, receptionist invariably told us they were all on business trips in China.

I learnt a lot about solar power & my own energy use habits. I found your website & the SAE consultant very informative. I have only rated the value for money as "good" as I see cheaper systems advertised now due to the end of the financial year. But overall I am happy with my choice & thank you again for your assistance.

The Salesman told me the system had a 15 year warranty and then the quote stated a 10 year warranty and after the installation I have only received warranty on the inverter from the manufacturer for 5 years.The install team were brilliant and the sales & office team were pleasant and professional - with the exception of the warranty issue.

Best decision we ever made. Yes we had way cheaper quotes, its not always about the money, its the product and the service. We looked at reviews prior to our appointment, saw good and bad reviews but decided to make out own decision. Glad we went with Citisolar.
Be well informed about systems to suit your requirements

The sales rep was knowledgable and very easy to talk to. He offered a discount and confirmed every thing with his superiors before going on .we were very happy with the companies approach. The installation was completed in a timely manner and the tradies doing the job were excellent.

Overall a good experience and everything was up and running quickly and smoothly For a great system at a great price although the sales person made a few promises like that he would come back out to check the system and make sure that we are happy which has not happened.

The Govt rebate for solar is now so low that it really does not make a lot of difference to your bill. Then if your inverter doesn't work and you need a replacement through warranty that takes weeks..... Their process for replacement is to get a new one from overseas.  They will not use their stock.  So after paying a mint for your new system you have to wait weeks to get a replacement and go without any solar power being taken off your bill.  Citisolar win - win.  Customer loose - loose!!!!
Needed to change Retailer, as Alinta Energy do not offer Rebate.Still waiting on SP Austnet to do their conversion of meter.
Yes, get at least three quotes. Had Energy aware call me a few days ago and the price for a 4 kW system had dropped to $6000. To late mine now installed. They were honest with me from the start.
Cannot say much until the system is installed.

Thank you for your online help, unfortunately only  2 companies through your online service contacted us.1 to make a time, which I couldn't do within the week, so he said he would call me back - I've yet to get that call.The second company was wanting to do everything over the phone, quoted me the wrong prices - which were rectified on his email and no further follow up.I was more than a little confused, took a drive around the neighbourhood, spotted 4 or 5 Citisolar signs and gave them a call, they presented well, gave lots of information and won our business.
Should spend more time explaining th system
